content: To sit the SNU admission exam, applicants first pay a $30 exam fee upfront. This applies to all applicants regardless of faculty. This fee is separate from and paid before any other admission charges. Only after passing the exam do applicants pay the remaining one-time admission charges.

After passing the SNU admission exam, admitted students pay a one-time $50 admin/registration charge (same for every faculty). Separately, they pay the $350 Foundation/EAP fee for the mandatory 1-year Foundation Programme. Ongoing costs use each faculty's per-semester service fee from the Administrative Charges table — not a one-time faculty admin charge and not a flat $125 for everyone.

Once enrolled at SNU (including during the Foundation year), students pay an ongoing per-semester service fee that varies by faculty: Education $50, Sharia & Islamic Studies $50, Agriculture & Environmental Science $80, Economic & Management Science $80, Languages $80, Law $80, Social Science $80, Veterinary Medicine & Animal Husbandry $80, Health Sciences & Tropical Medicine $100, Engineering $125, Medicine & Surgery $125, Science $125. This is paid every semester until graduation.

SNU students must renew their student ID card every 2 years of total enrollment (including the Foundation year) for a $10 fee. This is separate from the one-time $50 admin/registration charge paid after passing.

The mandatory Foundation Programme adds 1 year (2 semesters) to every undergraduate pathway. Those Foundation semesters are charged at the same faculty-specific per-semester rate as the degree years. Full-programme cost = $30 exam + $50 admin/registration + $350 EAP + (faculty rate × (original semesters + 2)) + ($10 × floor(totalSemesters/4)). Examples: Education $950; Science $1,700; Medicine & Surgery $2,210.
